pub fn get_iters_by_name<S>(state: &S, name: &str) -> Result<Option<u64>, Error>
where
    S: HasNamedMetadata,
{
    state
        .named_metadata_map()
        .get::<TuneableMutationalStageMetadata>(name)
        .ok_or_else(|| Error::illegal_state("TuneableMutationalStage not in use"))
        .map(|metadata| metadata.iters)
}
